title: Stamp 2: Bundestag and Bundesrat
meta_desc: A-Level German adventure on the Bundestag, Bundesrat, and the legislative process.

concepts.def: Federal parliament directly elected by the people; passes federal laws.
Federal council representing the Lander governments.
First vote; for a constituency candidate.
Second vote; for a party list, determining proportional representation.
Five-percent threshold; minimum vote share needed for parliamentary representation.
Coalition; standard form of government given proportional representation.

walkthroughs.body_html: Voters cast Erststimme for a local candidate and Zweitstimme for a party list. The Zweitstimme determines overall seat shares; the system combines majoritarian and proportional principles.
The Bundesrat consists of representatives from the 16 Lander governments. Many federal laws affecting the Lander require its consent (Zustimmungsgesetze), giving regions real federal-level power.

The Chancellor is elected by the Bundestag. Since no party usually wins a majority, coalitions form: classic CDU/CSU-FDP, grand coalition CDU/CSU-SPD, traffic light (SPD-Grune-FDP), Jamaica (CDU-Grune-FDP).
